hooks.command: if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q '.claude-plugin/marketplace.json\|.claude/skills/kaizen-orchestrator/SKILL.md'; then python3 scripts/sync-orchestrator.py --check-only 2>&1 || echo '⚠ kaizen-orchestrator drift — run: python3 scripts/sync-orchestrator.py'; fi

if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'skills/.*SKILL\.md|agents/.*\.md|\.claude-plugin/plugin\.json'; then python3 scripts/validate-plugin.py --check=refs,placeholders 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi
if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'skills/.*SKILL\.md|agents/.*\.md|\.claude-plugin/plugin\.json|evals/'; then python3 scripts/validate-plugin.py 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi
if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'harness/docs/guides/|harness/skills/|harness/agents/'; then echo '💡 harness 소스 변경 감지 — /docs-site 로 HTML 재생성 필요'; fi
